notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-handle-aid (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): HANDLE AID on a terminal RECEIVE: a key's own label, ANYKEY (not ENTER), a deactivated key, RESP, PUSH / POP HANDLE, and CLEAR / PA1 with no data. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: anykey-not-enter
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF7 / ANYKEY, ENTER pressed: ANYKEY is not ENTER, so no label; control goes on after the RECEIVE

scenarios.name: own-label
scenarios.why: PF7 pressed: PF7's own label, after the RECEIVE moved the data and set LENGTH

scenarios.name: anykey-pf
scenarios.why: PF9 pressed: no label of its own, so ANYKEY's

scenarios.name: deactivated
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF7 without a label deactivates the PF7 label set before it: no transfer

scenarios.name: resp-no-aid
scenarios.why: RESP on the RECEIVE: no action for the AID, the PF7 label is not taken

scenarios.name: push-suspends
scenarios.why: PUSH HANDLE after HANDLE AID PF7: the label is suspended, no transfer

scenarios.name: pop-restores
scenarios.why: PUSH HANDLE then POP HANDLE: the PF7 label is in effect again
